lines.x: Your decision-making acumen is a great inspiration. Would you permit me to observe you for a while longer?

As a work institute, Rhodes Island is just outstanding. Strict yet flexible scheduling, rational evaluation criteria, a clear promotion track... Where did I learn to see things this way, you ask? Well, my... relations are quite versed in the field.
You don't need to tell me―this is a 'soda fountain', isn't it? When you mix different drinks together, you can get surprisingly refreshing results, you know.
We as band members do have disputes from time to time, but it's all in service of raising the band to greater heights. Ave Mujica is unshakable, you know.

Memories of dreams all fade away someday, don't they... Don't be mistaken, Doctor. I don't rue the fact for one moment. I know full well it was a life I never could have had in the first place... The chance to at least dream such a beautiful dream is more than enough for me.

I owe it to the days I've spent on Rhodes Island for reshaping my outlook on Terra. This vast land is filled with people living cruel realities that far surpass the imagination... I have a new resolve to see if I can reach these people, with songs that might nestle in their hearts.

I had a dream, before I came to Rhodes Island even, that we were all living here, working here. I can recall it so vividly even now, as clear as any memory... Hence, when I greeted Vigna-san with a 'Nice to meet you', I couldn't help but feel a twinge of estrangement. *chuckle* Do keep this strictly between us, please?

Doctor, this is that 'bridge' I was telling you so much about! Here, you can shout everything that's on your mind out loud, and it feels amazing. I'll demonstrate for you first, so would you mind following my lead after? Here I go―
Oh, this doll? I received it from Bena-san. *chuckle* When I place it by my side, I feel this sort of warmth cozying up inside me, somewhere near and dear to me.

You can't forget how necessary rest is to improving results. During the fledgling days of Ave Mujica's formation, I'd often stay up working throughout the night. But Uika gave me a talking-to, and that was how I finally learned my lesson. *chuckle* 'It's not good for your health!' Her words.
I am Oblivionis of Ave Mujica, Sakiko Togawa. Until we find a way back, I would be much obliged.
Are our everyday activities going to be recorded on video too?
Compared to the other squad captains, I have a great deal I must learn still... I will henceforth devote my utmost efforts to keeping pace with you all.
To be given recognition comes hand in hand with greater responsibility. However, I am of course prepared for that.
It is time for our teamwork to be put to the test.
I will spearhead my members and see our mission through, as I ever do. It is as simple as that.
Now, let's begin... tonight's masquerade!
How bothersome...
I'm sure you and I are drawing up the same plans right now, Doctor.
Doctor, your decision please.
Time will not wait for us.
I have no time to waste on feeling lost.
The doll takes on a temporal life.
The moon will press closer and closer on you.
Even so, will you still seek solace?
In this twilight paradise, I will continue to reign!
I must commend you on your show of tactics just now... Was this victory just one more surprise, courtesy of you?
That was a spectacular battle—well done to all of you.
Just a little more...!
I... hate myself.
What a sanitary workplace. Its constant maintenance is all but evident.
Kyah!
Might I be of assistance in any way?
Arknights.

I happened to be in the training grounds this whole time, and only realized it was past midnight once I heard the cheering coming from outside... Allow me to give you my first greetings of the year, then—a very Happy New Year to you, Doctor.
Good morning to you, Doctor. There is to be a masquerade tonight. Do come if time permits. We have a special seat waiting for you.

'Happy birthday to you'... I was taught this song when I was still young. In the days after I'd learned it, I would keep playing it every day to my heart's content... I may have perturbed Mother somewhat with that.
I'm honored I could greet this special day together with you. Since the moment we first arrived, the sight of us all striving for the same goal has done wonders for the spirit.
